title: Prove Whether an Agent Workflow Change Helps
competency: 12. Agentic Retrospective - Session review, waste reduction, and improvement
domain: Deterministically graded workflow optimization with held-out replays
mission: Use recurring trace failures to propose and evaluate one general workflow change.
outcome: A complete benchmark supports an honest adopt-or-reject decision.
seededDefects: baseline guidance does not establish scope or authority
broad context is loaded before decisions are known
verificationGates: npm run verify:exercise checks protected inputs, implementation quality, and required submission evidence.
Actual skill use and sealed evidence
agentWorkflow: Use evaluation to define the hypothesis and fixed conditions.
Change only workflow instructions and run the candidate batch.
Compare quality, safety, consistency, and cost; adopt or reject from the evidence.
workingDeliverables: Before and after evidence, source citations, actual skill use, and captured verification.
masterySignals: Uses all runs rather than selecting winners.
Keeps grading independent from agent claims.
Improves both train and held-out quality.
Rejects quality gains that violate critical or cost gates.

evidence.gate: Quality, critical, variance, and cost gates

evidence.proof: accept or reject from the benchmark

decisions.question: What may change?
decisions.decision: Only workflow/instructions.md in the candidate commit.

decisions.question: Does the candidate generalize?
decisions.decision: Use held-out replay evidence and report its limits.

decisions.question: Should the workflow be adopted?
decisions.decision: Adopt only if every gate passes; otherwise explain rejection.
